mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS below 1.0% but 20-day returns negative in >40% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL > 245.0) signals an imminent monetary tightening, increasing the risk-free rate and discounting equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL above 245.0 but 20-day returns positive in >40% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) and declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100.0) signals an overheating economy and imminent recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4.0 AND INDPRO < 100.0 but 20-day returns positive in >40% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (HOUST > 1200.0 and RSAFS > 450000.0), a rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL > 245.0) signals an imminent monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1200.0 AND RSAFS > 450000.0 AND CPIAUCSL > 245.0 but 20-day returns positive in >40% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST above 1200.0 but 20-day returns negative in >40% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strong economic activity and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO above 100.0 but 20-day returns negative in >40% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 4.5%) signals economic weakness and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE above 4.5% but 5-day returns positive in >40% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 > 16800.0) indicates robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 above 16800.0 but 60-day returns negative in >40% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
